find_query: matrix rank over a prime finite field

input_contract.shape: At most 256 rows; nonempty rows have 1..256 columns; equal row lengths matching columns. Zero rows carry the explicit columns axis.

output_contract.prime: Integer greater than 1 and at most 2147483647.
output_contract.source: PrimeFieldMatrixRequest retaining the exact source matrix.

fit_reason: Prime 2; two rows of two integer canonical residues; explicit columns=2. This is exactly the requested finite-field matrix rank, not a nearby symbolic operation.
boundary: Only the rank of the characteristic-two linear 2x2 matrix is requested. No nonlinear formal map, reshaping theorem, composition theorem, or maximality assertion is encoded.
